title: CRFI Distinct-Theory Reduction Audit v001
purpose: Apply the previously adopted reduction/kill condition to the operational commitments of CRFI after V014, prior-art attack, feeling-specific decomposition, human H001, and theory discrimination audits.
kill_condition: If every operational CRFI commitment maps onto an existing strong theory or a straightforward conjunction of existing mechanisms without yielding a new divergent observable prediction, CRFI is not a distinct theory and must be reduced to a synthesis/implementation framework.

distinctness_rule.prior_art_escape: A commitment counts as distinct only if its operative requirement is not already present in a strong prior theory and is not a straightforward conjunction of such requirements.
distinctness_rule.prediction: It must yield at least one material, source-supported observable prediction that a strong rival denies under matched conditions.
distinctness_rule.ad_hoc_prohibition: Post-V014 source/proxy refinements do not count as original CRFI novelty unless independently justified and they survive their own falsifiability/novelty tests.
distinctness_rule.phenomenal_label_prohibition: Different phenomenal labels on identical observables do not count as divergent empirical predictions.

commitments.commitment: A local evaluative/content state E can drive automatic response without felt presence; additional system-level conditions are required.
commitments.coverage_note: Higher-order/global/re-entry accounts already distinguish local/first-order processing from conscious experience.

commitments.commitment: Feeling requires a sustained, integrated, differentiated, recurrent/re-entrant, repertoire-rich causal domain C.
commitments.coverage_note: Integration/differentiation/intrinsic causal structure, recurrent processing, global recurrent workspace, and recurrent-stability/integration criteria are established prior commitments.

commitments.commitment: Specific content E must participate bidirectionally in the wider domain; E changes S trajectory and S/context changes E.
commitments.coverage_note: Top-down workspace-to-local feedback, content-specific counterfactual availability, sensory/interoceptive re-entry, and circular predictive body-brain causality jointly occupy the operational territory.

commitments.commitment: Presence is modeled as the conjunction C AND L under the project's binary dissociation constraints.
commitments.coverage_note: The exact Boolean packaging may be project-specific, but V013 established necessity only inside the engineered model class and no strong-rival divergent empirical prediction has been validated.

commitments.commitment: Phenomenal quality is identified/approximated by intervention-defined relational causal geometry rather than raw activation alone.
commitments.coverage_note: IIT ties quality to intrinsic cause-effect distinctions/relations; N* explicitly develops perturbation-defined causal trajectory geometry and anchoring.

commitments.commitment: Feeling-relevant content is organism-relative evaluative/homeostatic significance rather than arbitrary information.
commitments.coverage_note: Homeostatic feeling, affective extended homeostasis, active interoception, regulatory affect/allostasis, and viability constraints are existing commitments.

commitments.commitment: Provisional post-V014 refinement: the independently defined current evaluative source itself, not merely a downstream proxy, must be reciprocally embedded.
commitments.coverage_note: Broad self-involvement/source-location territory is prior art; CRFI-S also faces source-relabeling and proxy-equivalence problems.

commitments.commitment: The CRFI architecture should uniquely support the selected later avoidance, recovery, learning/plasticity, and memory-like consequences of salient events.
commitments.coverage_note: V014 preregistered held-out test directly falsified behavioral uniqueness: the clean gated-learning rival matched immediate behavior and all frozen post-event equivalence criteria without direct S_to_E feedback.

commitments.commitment: If the relevant causal organization is realized, biological material is not itself the defining requirement.
commitments.coverage_note: Substrate-general or causal-organization-based realization is established territory; Damasio supplies an opposing biological-hybrid view, but artificial systems lack independent phenomenal ground truth.

commitments.commitment: A causally inert phenomenal permutation is empirically indistinguishable under physical intervention by construction.
commitments.coverage_note: The project's V009 simulation usefully formalized the consequence, but the principle is a methodological/no-go constraint rather than a positive distinctive feeling mechanism.

external_gate_results.theory_data_identifiability_v001: expected to be evaluated separately; no distinctness credit unless common identifiable data exist

decision_rule: DISTINCT_THEORY_SURVIVES only if at least one non-post-hoc mechanistic commitment has prior_art_escape=true and current_unique_observable_prediction=true. Otherwise REDUCE_TO_SYNTHESIS_FRAMEWORK.
